title: How a Club Membership or a Corporate Programme Bears on a Vacation Package
content:
Holding an active traveller club membership changes what a package among the Vacation Package Products is charged, and the product's own terms decide everything else.

> The following clause of that sentence is **no longer in force** and is not to be applied: "the club tier held on the deposit date decides the package discount applied to the price". It has been superseded by the current basis, and the position it stated no longer governs. That the product's own terms decide everything else continues to govern.

## Club and corporate are mutually exclusive

A club discount and a corporate programme rate are mutually exclusive: a package booked under a corporate programme takes the programme's negotiated price and no club discount on top, and only a product that permits corporate booking may be booked that way at all.

## Protection bought with the package

Travel protection bought together with the package takes the product's bundled discount, and that discount and the club insurance discount are never both applied; the larger of the two is taken.

| Discounts in play on a protection premium | What is applied |
| --- | --- |
| the product's bundled discount alone | the product's bundled discount |
| the club insurance discount alone | the club insurance discount |
| both | the larger of the two, and that one alone |

## Points on a package

Club points accrue on the package price actually paid, at the earn rate of the product booked, and never on the agency service fee, port charges, gratuities or visa assistance.

A package paid for entirely with a future travel credit earns no points at all.

## A tier that changes between deposit and departure

> The following clause is **no longer in force** and is not to be applied: "Where the member's tier changes between deposit and departure, the discount applied at deposit stands and is neither topped up nor clawed back." It has been superseded by the current basis, and the position it stated no longer governs.

superseded_clauses: the club tier held on the deposit date decides the package discount applied to the price
Where the member's tier changes between deposit and departure, the discount applied at deposit stands and is neither topped up nor clawed back.
